supported.name: Title background planes
supported.scope: The two static title planes after asset loading, before menu text, copyright text, selection colours, and palette animation.

supported.name: Options background plane
supported.scope: The static alternate frontend plane after asset loading, without text, cursor sprites, option values, or animated palette colours.

supported.name: Story background plane
supported.scope: The static story plane after asset loading, without story strings, Japanese glyph animation, raster motion, or transition effects.

unsupported.reason: Frontend_InitializeSegaScreen builds a sprite grid and planet pattern procedurally and the dissolve changes it over time.
TitleScreen_FinalizeInitialization queues region-dependent strings; TitleScreen_Update redraws menu strings and animates palette colours each frame.
UI_InitOptionsScreenLoadDisplay and its update path render text, changing values, a cursor sprite, and animated palette colours at runtime.
The password grid, character choices, and two cursor mappings are produced and updated by controller code rather than stored as one static layout.
StoryText_Dispatch and the JP-only StoryFont_UpdateAndDispatch add timed text and glyph animation over the supported static background.
Results_ActivatePostStageSummary queues indexed rows, then runtime routines draw scores, bonuses, history rows, and palette-dependent status.
Results_RenderScoreSummary composes labels and live statistics through text and number renderers rather than a static screen map.
The continue scene combines runtime text, counters, object sprites, and multiple palette-list states.
WeaponSetup_UpdateBackgroundEffect writes animated dither columns while selection text, slot sprites, and highlight palettes change at runtime.
The Game Over landscape is generated through perspective and raster routines from source art rather than stored as a complete static plane.
Credits scenes are a sequenced family with per-scene asset lists, moving sprites, text, and transitions rather than one static screen.
